breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Apply the given condition that end slopes are zero at both supports due to symmetry,' which directly repeats the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt. A simply supported beam under uniform load rotates at the supports; the end slopes are NOT zero. The ground truth removes this erroneous condition entirely, but the generated specification perpetuates the error.
